findings.title: Moved/renamed internal functions without updating or adding corresponding tests
findings.body: This PR removes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP`, and the local `SimpleCheckIn` TypedDict from `src/sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py`, moving/renaming them into the new `incidents.py` (as `try_incident_threshold`) and `incident_occurrence.py` (as `create_incident_occurrence`) modules. The changed-file list contains no test updates. Any existing tests that import these symbols directly (e.g. `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import get_failure_reason`) or that use `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence", ...)` to avoid hitting Kafka during `mark_failed` tests will now either fail to import or have their patch silently become a no-op (since the patched module/symbol no longer exists at that path), which can cause real occurrence/Kafka production calls to run unmocked during tests, or outright ImportError failures in CI.

findings.title: No new unit tests added for the newly split-out logic modules
findings.body: The refactor introduces two new logic modules, `incidents.py` and `incident_occurrence.py`, each containing previously-tested business logic (threshold detection, occurrence payload construction, failure-reason text generation). No corresponding test files (e.g. `test_incidents.py`, `test_incident_occurrence.py`) were added or referenced in this PR to validate the functions at their new locations, leaving the reorganized code without direct test coverage tied to its new module paths.
